caption_hook: Minnesota holds a lost giant lake, a failed continental split and some of the oldest rock in America.

layers.name: LAKE AGASSIZ CLAY
layers.hook: The floor of a giant lost lake
layers.what: As the ice sheet melted, Lake Agassiz grew larger than all of today's Great Lakes combined. When it drained, it left the flat, rich-soiled Red River Valley.
layers.bonus: Its leftover puddles include Red Lake and Lake of the Woods.

layers.name: ST. PETER SANDSTONE
layers.hook: Sand so pure it makes glass
layers.what: A warm shallow sea washed over the Midwest and left a thick blanket of nearly pure quartz sand. It is so soft you can dig it by hand, and so clean it is mined for glass.
layers.bonus: Saint Paul's Wabasha Street Caves were dug into it and once hosted a 1930s speakeasy.

layers.name: NORTH SHORE LAVA
layers.what: North America tried to rip apart here, and lava poured out for millions of years. The basalt stacked up miles thick and now forms the cliffs along Lake Superior.
layers.bonus: The same rift runs buried underground all the way down to Kansas.

layers.name: SIOUX QUARTZITE
layers.what: Ancient river sands were buried, cooked and squeezed until the grains fused into pink quartzite, one of the toughest rocks around. Thin seams of soft red pipestone lie between its layers.
layers.bonus: Native nations have quarried that red pipestone for pipes at Pipestone National Monument for centuries.

layers.name: MESABI IRON RANGE
layers.what: Iron-rich mud settled in a shallow sea when Earth's air first held oxygen, then hardened into the Biwabik Iron Formation. It fed the steel mills for over a century.
layers.bonus: Hibbing's Hull-Rust mine pit is over 3 miles long and nicknamed the Grand Canyon of the North.

layers.name: MORTON GNEISS
layers.what: Heat and pressure deep in the crust twisted this rock into swirling pink and black bands. It is one of the oldest rocks in the U.S. and shows up along the Minnesota River.
layers.bonus: Quarried near Morton, it is polished and sold as Rainbow Gneiss for buildings and countertops.
